title: Replicated consultant state (AMaxiConsultantCharacter -> UMaxiConsultantAnimInstance)
description: DEPRECATED in v2.0: the 3D consultant is disabled at runtime and not cooked; its Source stays untouched. The consultant is a 2D avatar in the web UI.

GestureTargetLocation.description: Replicated FVector, world; ZeroVector + bHasGestureTarget=false = none

GestureHeight.description: Low = vanity/cabinet, High = wall cabinet / mirror

FocusPlayer.description: Replicated APlayerState* of the visitor being addressed; each client's anim instance looks at its own camera when it is the focus player, else at the focus player's pawn

SpeechEnvelope.description: Local only (not replicated): 0..1 RMS of the PCM clip being played on this client, drives jaw/head bob

PlannerInstanceID.description: Replicated; which planner room this consultant belongs to
